Name: (CP) Yet Another Path Set
Author: Tiyara
Description:
I felt like in need of a sandstone-coloured tile path, so I made one. Also a few others.
All are craftable as soon as you know how to craft Crystal Path. I figured that at this point, you may have the base materials for these paths, including sap and a handful of geode minerals.

Also, Tortilla.

This mod does not replace anything.

Every single pixel on the tilesheet has been placed by hand, using colours of the minerals (and baked good) used.

It uses and thus requires Content Patcher.

Manifest.Name: Yet Another Path Set
Manifest.Description: Adds more path tiles, and their recipes.
